provenance.notes: In-house 3D source-panel (boundary-element) potential-flow solve on the actual STL, with a ground-image plane. Resolves the attached-flow pressure field and ground effect FROM GEOMETRY (not a curve fit), so geometry deltas are meaningful. Inviscid by construction: it does NOT resolve viscous separation, stall, or the real turbulent wake — that is what the written ANSYS Fluent deck / a RANS solve is for. Skin friction is a flat-plate estimate. Correlate against the tunnel/Fluent before trusting absolute levels; trust deltas more than levels. [80 panels]
